annotations.title: Student loan: repay or wait for the write-off

description: Whether a student loan is likely to be repaid or written off, what it costs over the term, and whether a voluntary overpayment helps. The balance and inflation start from the person's own figures when not given. Use for 'should I overpay my student loan', 'will my plan 2 loan be written off'.

annualInterestPct.description: Interest on the loan a year. Defaults to the plan's rate now: 4.1 for plans 1, 4 and 5, 6 for a postgraduate loan, and for plan 2 from 4.1 to 6 depending on salary.

annualSalaryGrowthPct.description: Real salary growth a year. Defaults to 2.

balance.description: Balance today, in pounds. Defaults to what their Liabilities say is owed on student loans.

inflationPct.description: Inflation a year. Everything is then in today's money, and a frozen repayment threshold falls by it each frozen year. Defaults to the inflation in Settings.

voluntaryOverpayment.description: A one-off overpayment today. Defaults to 0.

yearsAlreadyElapsed.description: Years since repayment began. Defaults to 0.
